title: Mark the Processor Worksite
briefing: Use HoloMap to create the first player waypoint for the processor worksite, then scan the worksite target if Lens is present.
fieldGuide: Pack #2 uses live HoloMap support from player waypoints. The Pack #2 layer JSON labels the route, while the waypoint is the real marker players create. The Lens scan unlocks processor docs without shipping final machine balance.

objectives.label: Create a HoloMap waypoint
objectives.detail: Drop a waypoint near the planned processor worksite.

objectives.label: Scan the processor worksite
objectives.detail: Inspect the planned processor controller or placeholder worksite marker.

rewards.label: Power Meter
rewards.detail: A useful diagnostic block for the next scan.

metadata.completionFeedback: Processor worksite marked. Depot request calibration is next.
